item.title: Olympics opening ceremony in Italy. Trump isn’t on the list
item.description: U.S. Vice President JD Vance will lead an American delegation to the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy and attend the opening ceremony, the White House said Saturday.

item.title: Shallotte fire kills one person, leaves another person and firefighter injured
item.description: Just before 2:00 p.m., the Shallotte Police and Fire Departments responded to a house fire at 4730 Milliken Street, with someone possibly trapped inside.

item.title: Broncos beat Bills but lose Nix, Seahawks rout 49ers to advance to conference championship games
item.description: The Denver Broncos are heading to the AFC championship game for the first time since winning their last Super Bowl 10 years ago, but they won’t have Bo Nix under center after the second-year quarterback broke his right ankle.

item.title: UNCW men win, women drop weekend contests at home
item.description: It was a busy weekend for UNCW basketball with three games being played over three days at Trask Coliseum, but it came with some mixed results.

item.title: With freezing temperatures dropping into the night, how NCDOT handles slippery roads
item.description: With it raining on Sunday, and temperatures dropping into freezing weather, black ice can occur. NCDOT is ready to help clean the roads, to make sure the morning commute is good.

item.title: Weekend events held throughout Cape Fear region honoring MLK
item.description: On Sunday morning, Ebenezer Missionary Baptist Church had a special service to honor Dr. Martin Luther King.

item.title: ’60 Minutes’ airs report on Trump deportations that was suddenly pulled a month ago
item.description: “60 Minutes” on Sunday aired its story about Trump administration deportations that was abruptly pulled from the newsmagazine's lineup a month ago, a move that had triggered an internal battle about political pressure that spilled out into the open.

item.title: Wildfires race across Chile, leaving 18 dead and forcing thousands to flee
item.description: Wildfires raging across central and southern Chile on Sunday left at least 18 people dead, scorched thousands of acres of forest and destroyed hundreds of homes, authorities said, as the South American country swelters under a heat wave.

item.title: One-Day Horse Camp
item.description: A horse camp for children ages 6-13 will be held in Hampstead by Cool Breeze Equestrian on January 19th from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.

item.title: Death toll in Spanish train collision rises to 39 and authorities say it could still rise
item.description: Spanish police said Monday that at least 39 people are confirmed dead in a high-speed train collision the previous night in the south of the country.
